notes.title: Update: Counselor Select Fix
notes.content: A small patch today to resolve an issue where counselor select would become unresponsive sometimes after playing multiple levels. Happy camping!

notes.title: "Colorado" Update
notes.content: [p]Hello camp managers! A few small updates today to keep things running smoothly:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Monsters will no longer play their attack animation when entering a space with hidden Counselors/Campers[/p][/*][*][p]Killing wisps now properly consumers a Counselor action[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a certain secret Counselor's tooltip to display correct description.[/p][/*][*][p]Reinstated a certain secret Counselor's inability to swim.[/p][/*][*][p]Scoring for "Hunt" levels will, sadly, now longer reward you for doing nothing[/p][/*][*][p]C&C will no longer gain phantom actions from Canoodling monsters into a certain secret counselor[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed competing end-level messages on certain levels when replayed[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Hotfix 6/12
notes.content: [list][*][p]Fixed a situation in which Camp Inspector Johnson could be more immortal than he should be,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a potential situation in which swimming was not correctly ending a counselor's turn[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 5/21
notes.content:
A few small updates have been pushed for the Camp Keepalive: Endless Summer demo version.

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with Evil Clowns causing Counselor turns to be skipped
[*] Fixed an "infinite footstep" SFX bug on clicking on some counselors,
[*] Clicking on counselors or campers while moving now selects the space beneath them correctly,
[*] Fixed camera bounds to scale dynamically and not allow infinite scrolling,
[*] Fixed some missing minimap icons during level preview
[/list]

[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced difficulty of Extremely Fatal Attraction to ramp up a little more slowly
[*] Help screen "Controls" section now updated with all controller actions
[/list]

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Camp Inspector Johnson now has a visible detection range for Camper deaths
[*] Left Trigger/CTRL now displays tooltips for all monsters onscreen
[/list]
